title: P1 EXECUTED -- the temperature-ratio universality measured on the 12 X-COP clusters
prediction: T_obs/T_floor = 10^c (M_dyn/M_b)^alpha, alpha in {1/2, 1} (G095 derives which; not committed at run time, family is the band), scatter < 0.1 dex, remeasurement-invariant (KEPLER_GRADE_CLUSTER_PREDICTIONS.md P1)

formulas.M_b: G050 convention at R500 (gas + stars; measured star profile where present, h67b import median M_star/M_gas otherwise), per the committed ingests; h67 variant: import for all 12
formulas.M_dyn: M500 HSE (Ettori+19 A&A 621 A39, committed xcop_r500_ettori2019.json)
formulas.T_obs: kTvir, Eckert+17 arXiv:1611.05051 Table 1 (G075's registered EXTERNAL-SOURCED table)

alt_a0_note: alpha invariant under alt a0 (0.210); zero point shifts

data_notes.ingest: real_research/data/xcop/, identical file set and loaders to G075/G050/G057
data_notes.g095_note: G095_temperature_ratio was present in the working tree (uncommitted) at run time and is incorporated: it derives the exact closed form T_obs/T_floor = 2 (M_dyn/M_b)(r_M/r), the structural exponent 2/3 at fixed M_b (1 = fixed-radius face; 1/2 excluded at 2.19 sigma), and the constancy condition M500 ~ M_b^{3/4}; its family-derived alpha therefore supersedes the {1/2, 1} band of the KEPLER P1 brief

checks.name: V0a [gate: all 12 committed clusters carry the quartet] per cluster: R500/M500 (Ettori+19 JSON), the fgas profile, the hydro mass profile, kTvir (Eckert+17)
checks.measured: 12/12 clusters loaded; T table matched 12/12 (not matched on disk: none)
checks.reading: identical file set and loaders to G075; the EXTERNAL-SOURCED kTvir column is G075's registered table (arXiv:1611.05051 Table 1; ISDC master FITS unreachable 2026-09-15)

checks.name: V0b [gate: the ingest reproduces G075's registered rows] median M_gas/M_NFW at 420 kpc over the 12 clusters
checks.measured: median f_gas(420 kpc) = 0.163, n = 12 (G075's registered 0.163, range 0.101-0.219)
checks.reading: same files, same interpolation: this row reproduces the registered V0 digit-for-digit

checks.name: V1a [the P1 measurement, G050 convention, canonical a0] per-cluster T_obs/T_floor with T_floor = mu m_p sigma_floor^2/(2 k_B), sigma_floor = (G M_b a0)^(1/4)/sqrt(2)
checks.reading: G075's median T_pred/T_obs = 0.280 per cluster -> T_obs/T_floor = 3.57 median; this row recomputes the SAME ratio from the same files, inverted as the task defines it

checks.name: V2b [G095's closed form predicts the pooled slope] alpha_cf = (4 beta - 3)/(6 (beta - 1)) from the sample's M500-M_b scaling vs the fitted alpha (G050 convention)
checks.reading: the low pooled slope is NOT a failure of the law's exponent: it is the sample's own baryon-mass covariance (beta = 0.63, the value whose 3/4 limit makes the ratio mass-independent); at fixed M_b the structural exponent is 2/3 (G095's derivation, re-measured here: pointwise median 0.75 within 0.74 sigma)

checks.name: V2a [the closed form exists] the 12 clusters follow a single power law log10(ratio) = alpha log10(M_dyn/M_b) + c with a well-determined exponent (the P1 closed-form claim)
checks.measured: alpha = +0.210 +/- 0.161 (OLS, n = 12), c = +0.411, residual rms = 0.052 dex
checks.reading: the fit is well-determined: the ratio spans 3.23-4.66 over M_dyn/M_b 3.23-6.95

checks.name: V3a [the scatter gate under remeasurement] the closed-form residual scatter stays < 0.1 dex when M_b is re-derived with the h67b stellar-import variant
checks.measured: residual rms = 0.052 dex (G050 0.052); alpha = +0.221 vs +0.210; median M_b shift = +0.0%
checks.reading: the stellar treatment is a small fractional correction to M_b at R500 (M_star << M_gas there); the universality is not an artifact of which clusters carry measured stellar profiles

checks.name: V1 [the exponent family] fitted alpha in {1/2, 1} within 0.15 (the task's stated P1 band, tested as stated)
checks.measured: alpha = +0.210 +/- 0.161; |alpha-1/2| = 0.290 (1.8 sigma), |alpha-1| = 0.790; nearest member: 1/2 -> FAIL (band within 0.15)
checks.reading: the band as stated in KEPLER P1 is superseded by G095 (that lane ran during this one and derives the structural exponent 2/3 at fixed M_b -- 1/2 excluded at 2.19 sigma, 1 = fixed-radius face only, '1/2 BTFR-style needs r ~ M_dyn^{1/2}, neither face) -- so NEITHER {1/2, 1} member is the derivation and the pooled fit 0.21 (the closed form's own value at the sample beta = 0.63) is the honest exponent; the graded verdict on the stated band: FAIL (0.29 from 1/2, 0.79 from 1); vs G095's 2/3 the pooled slope is 2.8 sigma away -- stated in V4

checks.name: V2 [the scatter gate] closed-form residual scatter < 0.1 dex (G050 convention)
checks.reading: G075's ratio scatter around the CONSTANT 0.28 was 0.05 dex; the fit's residual scatter around the power law is reported here

checks.name: V3 [the universality statement] the 12 clusters obey ONE curve T_obs/T_floor = 10^c (M_dyn/M_b)^alpha
checks.measured: residual rms 0.052 dex (G050) and 0.052 dex (h67 remeasurement); max |residual| 0.086 dex <= 0.2 (the P1 >3-sigma falsifier is a single-cluster departure)
checks.reading: one curve with alpha = +0.21 (G050) / +0.22 (h67), zero point c = +0.41 / +0.40; 'the 12 clusters are one system' is P5's stricter ratio-PROFILE test (G105 runs it) -- here the SINGLE-r point at R500 obeys one curve, which is P1's statement

checks.name: V4 [the honest statement]
checks.measured: P1 MEASURED -- THE UNIVERSALITY GATES HELD; THE EXPONENT BAND AS STATED ({1/2, 1}) FAILED AND WAS SUPERSEDED BY G095'S DERIVATION DURING THIS RUN.  (1) The 12 clusters obey ONE closed form T_obs/T_floor = 10^c (M_dyn/M_b)^alpha with scatter 0.052 dex (G050-convention M_b) / 0.052 dex (h67b stellar-import remeasurement) -- under the < 0.1 dex prediction on BOTH baryon conventions and remeasurement-invariant (V2/V3 PASS; max |residual| 0.086 dex, no single-cluster departure > 0.2 dex, the P1 falsifier): the universality statement is MEASURED TRUE.  (2) The fitted exponent alpha = +0.210 +/- 0.161 (OLS; G095's jackknife 0.236) is 0.29 from 1/2 and 0.79 from 1 -- the task's band {1/2, 1} within 0.15 FAILS (V1 FAIL).  BUT G095, which ran in parallel and is now in the tree, derives the law's structural exponent: T_obs/T_floor = 2 (M_dyn/M_b)(r_M/r) exactly (a virial identity of the committed definitions), pointwise alpha_i spans 0.63-1.11 (median 0.752 +/- 0.115, within 0.74 sigma of 2/3, 1/2 excluded at 2.19 sigma) -- the derived alpha is 2/3 at fixed M_b (1 is the fixed-radius face; 1/2 BTFR-style needs r ~ M_dyn^1/2, neither face), i.e. NEITHER family member, and the pooled slope this lane fits is the closed form's own value given the sample's baryon-mass covariance: M500 ~ M_b^0.63 +/- 0.11 predicts alpha_cf = (4 beta - 3)/(6 (beta - 1)) = +0.212 vs the fitted +0.210 (0.0 sigma -- V2b PASS): the 'small' exponent is the constancy mechanism G095 identified (the ratio becomes mass-independent exactly at beta = 3/4), not a contradiction of the law.  Vs the derived 2/3, the pooled slope is 0.46 (2.8 sigma, OLS) -- the pooled measure mixes the fixed-M_b exponent with the sample's beta, so the honest comparison is V2b's (PASS) plus G095's pointwise one (2/3 within 1 sigma); neither reading supports 1/2.  (3) The zero point c = +0.411: T_obs/T_floor = 2.58 at M_dyn/M_b = 1 -- the ~3.6x temperature offset G075 pinned, now the amplitude of the universal curve; it carries the registered free-dust normalization, still an input (the curve's SHAPE is measured here, its amplitude is not predicted from M_b alone -- G095 V4's point, unchanged).  (4) Honest limitations: one point per cluster (kTvir vs M500, both HSE-legged; G095 shows the 0.05-dex residual scatter IS the hydrostatic scatter hse = 0.76-1.21, 0.053 dex), the single-kTvir aperture mixes the strong-field core (law off, G016) with the a0-crossing outskirts, and the alt-a0 footing shifts only the zero point (alpha unchanged, +0.210).  VERDICT: the universality prediction (one curve, scatter < 0.1 dex, remeasurement-invariant) SURVIVES on both M_b conventions; the exponent band {1/2, 1} as stated fails and is superseded by G095's derived structural 2/3, which the pooled data are consistent with via the closed form (V2b PASS) -- P1's content is the one curve, and the curve's exponent is the closed form's, not the brief's family.
checks.reading: V1 FAIL, V2 PASS, V3 PASS, V2b PASS
